name: Bolgar Historical and Archaeological Complex
description: Bolgar is the ruined medieval city on the banks of the Volga, south of Kazan in Tatarstan. Founded by the Volga Bolgars, it thrived from the 7th to the 15th century and briefly served as the first capital of the Golden Horde. Visitors wander among the remains of an early Islamic centre, where the Bolgars adopted their new faith in 922, and it is still a pilgrimage site for Tatar Muslims.
